difficulty_reason: The proof is the quasi-compact-immersion instance of the intermediate-step descent pattern: the framework lemma's assumptions follow from the cited locality lemmas for closed immersions and quasi-compact morphisms; a quasi-compact immersion is in particular quasi-affine, so the delivered descent of quasi-affineness makes $X$ a scheme with $X \to Z$ quasi-affine, and the scheme-side fpqc descent lemma concludes.
